title: Adams filtrations and secondary coherence for fibers of Steenrod operations
summary: Let $f:Y\to\prod_λΣ^{d_λ}H\mathbb F_2$ be a locally finite family of positive-degree stable operations, where $Y=H\mathbb F_2$ or $H\mathbb Z$; in the integral case assume $d_λ\geq2$. We determine the Adams filtration of its fiber from the minimal generators of $\operatorname{im}(f^*)$ as a left Steenrod module. An explicit target automorphism separates a minimal subfamily from the redundant coordinates and gives a noncanonical stable splitting.
